ai_summary: Here is an executive summary of the financial document:  Aditya Birla Capital Limited is seeking shareholder approval via postal ballot for material related party transactions totaling up to INR 4,950 Crores with its holding company, Grasim Industries Limited, for the current fiscal year (2026-27). While the resolution states these transactions will be on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business, the document lacks crucial specific details regarding the nature of these substantial transactions. This significant lack of transparency concerning the type and specifics of such a large related party transaction constitutes a primary red flag for investors assessing potential conflicts of interest and the true financial impact on the company.
